description: This Java source file defines the CommandHandler class, which manages MQTT command subscriptions, acknowledgments (PUBACKs), and related timers within an Eclipse Hono MQTT adapter implementation.

classes.name: CommandHandler
classes.description: Manages MQTT command subscriptions, acknowledgments, and timers, tracking pending commands and handling PUBACKs.

classes.name: PendingCommandRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates information about a pending command request, including timer ID, tenant object, subscription, and command context.

methods.name: handlePubAck
methods.description: Handles PUBACK packets received from devices, cancels timers, and executes post-acknowledgment actions.

methods.name: addToWaitingForAcknowledgement
methods.description: Stores a message ID along with associated tenant, subscription, and command context, and starts a timeout timer.

methods.name: removeFromWaitingForAcknowledgement
methods.description: Removes and returns the pending command request associated with a given message ID.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Adds a command subscription and its message consumer to the internal tracking map.

methods.name: removeSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription by topic, optionally invoking a consumer, and closes the command consumer.

methods.name: removeAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions and their consumers.

methods.name: closeCommandConsumer
methods.description: Closes a command consumer and logs success or failure.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a timeout timer for a command message ID, logging timeout events.

methods.name: cancelTimer
methods.description: Cancels a timer given its ID.
